CBD.note: Air Force base with no airline flights. Only a twice-weekly Andaman administration Dornier service (Port Blair to Car Nicobar to Campbell Bay, Mondays and Fridays, about 10 seats, flown with Air Force aircraft) exists, and it is not on normal flight-booking sites.

CDP.note: Only IndiGo; mostly Hyderabad, with Bengaluru on some days. Sources disagree on other routes.

KJB.note: Very low traffic, about one IndiGo flight a day to Bengaluru; routes here have been cut before.

PUT.note: No scheduled airline flights since 2008. Used for charter, VIP and medical-emergency flights only.

RJA.area: Madhurapudi, about 16 km north of Rajahmundry

DEP.note: Army-used airstrip with no scheduled flights; Airports Authority of India has only plans to develop it, with no date.

HGI.area: Hollongi, about 14 km south of Itanagar

IXT.note: Only a few flights a week on small Alliance Air planes, and traffic fell sharply last year; confirm the date before relying on it.

IXV.note: Indian Air Force airfield; a civil section has only been proposed, no passenger flights.

TEI.note: Only Alliance Air, on some days of the week (the Itanagar link is a small Dornier flying Tuesday and Thursday); daytime flying only.

ZER.note: Very few flights (about 1 to 2 a week on a small plane, only 640 passengers last year); I could not confirm a current 2026 timetable, so verify before telling anyone to fly here.

DIB.area: Mohanbari, about 15 km east of Dibrugarh city

IXI.note: Only Alliance Air, a few flights a week; passenger numbers halved last year and sources disagree on Guwahati and Shillong.

RUP.area: Rupsi, about 17 km north of Dhubri (western Assam)
RUP.note: Only Alliance Air, a couple of flights a week; this airport has stopped for long gaps before.

TEZ.note: Passenger flights suspended since 1 Oct 2024 for runway work; not reopened as of late July 2026 and no reopening date given.

DBD.note: No scheduled flights since 1987; a new airport at Baliapur is only at proposal and feasibility stage.

GAY.area: About 12 km from Gaya city, close to Bodh Gaya
GAY.note: Domestic flights run all year; the international flights (Bangkok, Paro, Yangon) are a winter-season schedule, late October to March 2027.

MZU.note: Not started yet; upgrade work and a flight start date are still pending as of mid-2026.

AHA.area: Darima, about 12 km south of Ambikapur
AHA.note: Only 4 flights a week (Delhi Mon and Wed, Kolkata Thu and Sat), restarted 30 Mar 2026 and routed via Bilaspur.

JGB.note: Mainly Hyderabad, around 10 flights a week; Raipur link is thin.

PAB.note: Only Alliance Air with a few flights a week; older Bhopal and Indore routes were suspended.

DIU.note: IndiGo's Diu to Surat sector was removed from sale for winter 2026; the IndiGo 'Mumbai' flights go to Navi Mumbai airport.

NMB.note: New airport: Delhi flights began 16 Jul 2026; the Mumbai and Ahmedabad flights run only 3 days a week (Tue, Thu, Sat).

BHU.note: Flights go to Navi Mumbai airport, not Mumbai (BOM); passenger numbers fell 73% last year.

HSR.area: Hirasar, about 30 km from Rajkot city
HSR.note: This is Rajkot's only airline airport; the old city airport (RAJ) no longer has passenger flights.

IXK.area: About 4 km from Keshod town; 39 km from Junagadh and 50 km from Veraval
IXK.note: Only Alliance Air with a few flights a week (some Mumbai flights stop at Diu); traffic is very low.

IXY.area: About 7.5 km from Gandhidham and 20 km from Kandla port
IXY.note: Only one airline (SpiceJet) and one route (Mumbai); a Delhi route listed earlier is not in the current table.

PBD.note: Only two days a week (Thursday and Saturday); SpiceJet's earlier Mumbai flight appears to have stopped in April 2026.

RAJ.note: Old Rajkot airport lost all scheduled passenger flights on 10 Sep 2023; use Rajkot International (HSR) at Hirasar instead.

DHM.note: Short hill runway: flights are daylight-only and can be cancelled by weather; the IndiGo Chandigarh flight runs 4 days a week.

KUU.area: Bhuntar, 11 km from Kullu and 52 km from Manali
KUU.note: Only Alliance Air; frequency changes through the year (3 to 7 days a week in 2026) and weather or the short runway can cut seats, so check dates.

SLV.note: Only Alliance Air, about 6 days a week (no Tuesday Delhi flight in the May 2026 schedule); one aircraft bay and past suspensions, so check dates.

HSS.note: Only Alliance Air, a few state-supported flights a week; I could not find an Oct 2026 timetable, and an earlier 2019 service here stopped within months.

IXW.note: Scheduled flights have ended: IndiaOne Air stopped Kolkata in May 2026 and Bhubaneswar on 1 Sep 2026, and might return only if the state funds it.

RJI.note: The airport exists but no airline flies there.

BEP.note: No passenger flights since 2018. Flights for the Ballari area use Jindal Vidyanagar airport at Toranagallu (code VDY).

GBI.area: Srinivas Saradagi, about 12 km east of Kalaburagi
GBI.note: Only one daily evening flight, to Bengaluru. Service was suspended from Oct 2025 until mid-2026.

IXG.note: Star Air launched a daily Mumbai flight in March 2026 but it was not in the late-October listings.

IXX.note: Flights only on some days (about 5 a week), all to Bengaluru. Service was suspended in 2025 and restarted in June 2026.

MYQ.note: Only two daily flights (Hyderabad and Chennai), both in the afternoon.

RQY.note: Only Star Air flies here, and different cities are served on different days, so check the date you want.

VDY.area: Toranagallu (JSW Vidyanagar), about 30 km from Ballari; the airport used for Hampi
VDY.note: Only one daily flight, to Bengaluru, mid-morning.

AGX.note: Most flights go to Kochi; Bengaluru and Goa have fewer flights.

SHL.area: Umroi, about 30 km from Shillong city
SHL.note: Few flights: IndiGo to Kolkata daily and SpiceJet to Delhi only on some days. Runway extension work started in Aug 2026.

AKD.note: No scheduled passenger flights; listed as general aviation only, with a runway extension planned.

AVR.area: Belora, about 15 km south of Amravati
AVR.note: Only about 3 flights a week, all to Mumbai (seen on Wednesday and Friday).

GDB.area: Birsi, about 17 km north-east of Gondia
GDB.note: IndiGo (Hyderabad) stopped on 1 May 2026 and Star Air (Indore) paused in May 2026; no flights were found in late October. Wikipedia mentions a Star Air restart but I could not confirm it.

ISK.area: Ozar, about 20 km north-east of Nashik city

IXU.note: A rename to Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar Airport has been ordered but is on hold, so airlines may show either name.

JLG.note: Small turboprop flights, only a couple a day; Navi Mumbai route is new for winter 2026-27.

LTU.note: No scheduled passenger flights; listed as general aviation only. Kingfisher flew here years ago.

NDC.note: Only Star Air flies here, and not every route runs every day.

NMI.area: Ulwe, Navi Mumbai; a separate airport from Mumbai's main airport (BOM)
NMI.note: Opened for passengers on 25 Dec 2025; many flights a day (25+ departures in one morning), but it is not the old Mumbai airport.

RTC.note: No scheduled flights yet; it is a Coast Guard air station and civil flights under UDAN are only planned (agreement signed July 2026).

SAG.area: Kakadi, about 15 km south-west of Shirdi town
SAG.note: Only IndiGo flies here, and passenger numbers fell about 18% last year.

SDW.note: Only Fly91 flies here; a Navi Mumbai route has been announced but its start was not confirmed.

SSE.note: Fly91 paused Solapur flights for the 2026 monsoon and Star Air's Mumbai flight was due back on 1 Aug, but no flights showed for 27-31 Oct; confirm before relying on it.

DPP.note: Wikipedia says two services link Datia with Bhopal and Khajuraho, but only 800 passengers flew in FY2025-26 and no airline or flights were found, so treat it as having no regular flights.

GUX.note: Guna is only an airstrip with no scheduled passenger flights.

GWL.note: Some routes (for example Akasa's Delhi flight) do not run daily.

HJR.note: Only about 2 flights a day, to Delhi and Varanasi; traffic fell 18% last year.

REW.note: IndiGo's Indore flight is daily; Alliance Air flights to Delhi, Bhopal and Raipur run on different days.

TNI.note: The airport has a licence but no airline flies there yet (zero passengers in FY2025-26).

AJL.area: Lengpui, about 32 km north of Aizawl
AJL.note: The airport is a long drive (about 32 km) from Aizawl.

PYB.note: Two flights a day on a small 9-seat plane (IndiaOne Air); book early.

RRK.note: Only one daily flight, to Bhubaneswar, on a small plane; service was halted for about six months in 2025.

UKE.area: Utkela, about 15 km north of Bhawanipatna
UKE.note: Two daily flights to Bhubaneswar on a small 9-seat plane.

AIP.note: Few flights; no direct Delhi flight. Star Air's Nanded flight goes via Hindon.

BUP.note: Only Alliance Air to Delhi, a few days a week; traffic fell by about half last year, so check the exact days before booking.

HWR.area: Halwara, roughly 25-30 km west of Ludhiana
HWR.note: New airport (first commercial flight 15 May 2026); only Air India to Delhi, two flights a day. This replaces the old Ludhiana (Sahnewal) airport.

IXP.note: Government lists Pathankot among UDAN airports with no flights (Dec 2025); I found no restart in 2026. Nearest working airport is Amritsar.

LUH.note: Old Sahnewal airport has no scheduled flights; the only operator (FlyBig) stopped in 2025. Use Halwara (HWR) for Ludhiana.

PNY.note: Only IndiGo flies here; no direct Delhi or Chennai flight.

BKB.note: Only one daily flight, to Delhi. A listed Alliance Air or Air India Regional Delhi service could not be confirmed for 2026.

JSA.note: Winter-season airport: flights run about October to March and the airport is closed to passenger flights April to September. Winter 2026-27 flights restart around 25 Oct 2026.

KQH.note: Small-aircraft and few-per-week flights on several routes; check the days for your route.

KTU.note: No scheduled flights since 1997; a new Kota-Bundi airport is only planned for 2027 or later.

PYG.note: No scheduled flights since 2024 (zero passengers in 2025-26); Sikkim's government is still trying to restart them. Use Bagdogra (IXB) instead.

BPM.note: Begumpet is used for private, training and air-force flying only; no airline flights since 2008. Use Hyderabad (HYD) at Shamshabad.

RMD.note: Only an old airstrip; a new airport is at the pre-feasibility study stage, no flights.

WGC.note: No airline flights; the airport is being rebuilt (tenders called Sep 2026), with work expected to take about two years.

NVY.note: Built under UDAN but no airline has started flights; I found no 2026 report of any service.

SXV.note: Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Kochi flights have ended. From 1 Nov 2026 only IndiGo to Chennai, twice a day; until 31 Oct only 3 days a week.

TJV.note: Air-force base; a civil terminal is only planned (land handed over June 2026, awaiting AAI approval). Use Tiruchirappalli (TRZ).

IXH.note: Closed since 1990; Tripura is working to revive it (Oct 2026) but no flights. Use Agartala (IXA).

IXN.note: Non-operational airstrip, no flights. Use Agartala (IXA).

IXQ.note: Non-operational airstrip, no flights. Use Agartala (IXA).

AGR.note: Only IndiGo, to two cities. For Delhi use rail or road.

AZH.note: Government lists Azamgarh among non-operational UDAN airports; zero passengers in 2025-26. Use Varanasi or Gorakhpur.

BEK.note: Only IndiGo; Delhi flights run only a few days a week. Navi Mumbai and Noida flights are listed on Wikipedia but I could not confirm them.

CWK.note: Government lists Chitrakoot among non-operational UDAN airports; only private flights now. Use Prayagraj (IXD) or Varanasi.

DXN.area: Jewar, about 56 km from Noida city centre and about 75 km from New Delhi
DXN.note: New airport (flights from 15 June 2026), far from Delhi with no metro link yet; Akasa has cut some routes since launch.

HRH.note: Government lists Aligarh among non-operational UDAN airports; the only operator (FlyBig) has shut down. Use Delhi or Agra.

IXD.note: IndiGo adds Mumbai, Hyderabad and Bengaluru flights from 25 Oct 2026; the Bhubaneswar flight is being cut back. Akasa and Alliance Air flights are listed but I could not confirm them for October 2026.

KBK.area: Kushinagar, about 47 km east of Gorakhpur
KBK.note: No scheduled flights since Nov 2023 (only occasional charters). Use Gorakhpur (GOP).

KNU.area: Chakeri, about 17 km from Kanpur city centre
KNU.note: Only IndiGo. Delhi and Mumbai flights are confirmed daily; Bengaluru is listed but I could not confirm a direct flight.

MZS.note: FlyBig's Lucknow flight stopped in Nov 2024; the airline has since shut down. Government lists Moradabad as non-operational.

PGH.area: Pantnagar, about 26 km from Haldwani and 65 km from Nainital
PGH.note: Only IndiGo to Delhi on a small ATR aircraft; a Noida route was announced but not confirmed. Traffic fell about 29 percent last year.

SWN.note: Air-force base; only VIP and military flying, no airline flights.

VSV.area: Near Tulsipur, about 17 km from Shravasti
VSV.note: Government lists Shravasti among non-operational UDAN airports; zero passengers in 2025-26 and the only operator (FlyBig) has shut down.

COH.note: IndiaOne Air's 9-seater Kolkata service has ended (listed as terminated around Jan 2026); I found no replacement operator. Use Bagdogra (IXB).

LDA.note: No passenger flights since the 1980s; only VIP helicopters. A runway extension survey began in July 2026.

RDP.area: Andal, about 17 km from Durgapur city centre

RGH.note: Not in operation; the state says 19-seater flights may start in 2027.
